TAT Technologies will release its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, before market open on Wednesday, August 5, 2026.


Management will host a webcast and conference call to review the results that day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


**[Register to join the Webcast >](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_MRtan_3wQoG9XfDYLkuNeA#/registration)**
